pass_scope: 940 same-face pairs of all 57 fitted SMT parts clear 0.2 mm under the explicitly listed centered package-envelope screen; this is not a factory process guarantee.
assumptions_and_limits: All body envelopes are centered at their native footprint pose except U2, whose union encloses the two documented source registrations. Right-angle orientation is required and asserted.

The 0.2 mm threshold is from JLC's order-specific email. All 940 same-face pairs are evaluated. Opposite faces, bare lands, U6DNP, hand-fitted C5/antennas/solar and rails/nozzle access are outside this SMT-body pair screen.

A PASS means the stated numerical package envelopes clear the threshold at design centers. It is not a guarantee of assembly yield, machine placement accuracy, solder spread, dimensional origin tolerances or thin-board deformation.

Sources distinguish documented package dimensions from conservative engineering allowances. Some passive supplier dimensions were not independently tolerance-certified; their enlarged screen boxes are explicit assumptions.

MAX-M10S conservative envelope stacks maximum body and uncertain residual tab projection at either length end. Manufacturer recommended component keepout is also reported. This is a precautionary envelope, not evidence of an observed collision.

U1 pin1 corner is derived from actual pad1 and mirrored X for the bottom component-facing view. It must remain upper-left in the new factory DFM; a numeric CPL angle alone is not proof of orientation.
